decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

(Reason.  To accord with the provisions of Section 92(1) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990)

Condition : 2 - The front boundary wall shall be constructed at the location shown on drawing "Plan showing layout front garden", but at a height of no greater than 0.6m and shall be permanently retained thereafter.

(Reason:To protect the appearance of the area and in the interest of highway safety, in accordance with adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV- B.1.1 (New Development) and T.1.4 (Car & cycle parking & servicing facilities for development).

(Reason: To maintain highway and pedestrian safety.)

Condition : 4 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.

Condition : 5 - Alternative access arrangements do not exist to the rear of the property. The proposed crossover would not result in an unnecessary decline in highway and pedestrian safety on this busy classified road and complies with adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New development), T.4.4 (Road safety) and T.5.3 (Vehicular crossovers and hardstandings).
